name: EAGLE-2: Faster Inference of Language Models with Dynamic Draft Trees (arXiv:2406.16858)
notes: arXiv:2406.16858. EAGLE-2: Faster Inference of Language Models with Dynamic Draft Trees. By Yuhui Li et al. Submitted 2024-06-24. Improves speculative decoding with context-aware dynamic draft trees. Achieves 3.05x-4.26x speedup over EAGLE-1.
